messages.author: Zeyu Lin
messages.body:
Hello Amber users,
I am trying to add membrane for my protein. The Amber tutorial says people
can use OPM to add membrane, with --preiented flag. However, I cannot find
this flag in Amber Mannual, and I do not know how to use it. Can someone
help me with this? Thank you.
BW,
Zeyu

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Jan 07, 2025, Zeyu Lin via AMBER wrote:
>
>I am trying to add membrane for my protein. The Amber tutorial says people
>can use OPM to add membrane, with --preiented flag. However, I cannot find
>this flag in Amber Mannual, and I do not know how to use it. Can someone
>help me with this? Thank you.
OPM is not a part of Amber (and hence not in the Amber Manual).  You will
probably need to contact the folks at Michigan for help with this.  If you
could point us to which Amber tutorial you are looking at, we may be able to
figure out who wrote that, and see if it can be clarified.
(Of course, some one on the list may know something and reply, but that is a
bit of a long shot.)
....dac
